title: Workspace
description: A builder's workspace: the folder holding their ventures. A workspace.json at its top says which schema version it follows and where to find spheres (EE-002).

schema_version.description: The version in schema/VERSION that this workspace follows

spheres.description: Folders to search for sphere.json files, relative to the workspace. Grouping folders inside them (for example ventures/companies/ or ventures/hobbies/) are for people to browse and carry no meaning; each sphere.json is the truth.

code.description: Optional folder holding code repos, mirroring the sphere folders so a repo sits under the same sphere as its notes
